name: Example: Add user preferences
description: Add a user preferences table and API endpoints for theme/notification settings

tasks.name: schema-preferences
tasks.description: Add userPreferences table to all 3 schema files and register in db/index.ts
tasks.prompt: Add a `userPreferences` table with columns: id (text PK), userId (text FK to users), theme (text, default 'system'), emailNotifications (boolean, default true), dashboardLayout (text, JSON string for layout prefs), createdAt, updatedAt. Add to all 3 schema files (SQLite, MySQL, PG), register in db/index.ts ActiveTables, and add CREATE TABLE + ALTER TABLE migration in init.ts.

tasks.name: api-preferences
tasks.description: Create tRPC router for user preferences CRUD
tasks.prompt: Create a new tRPC router at src/trpc/routers/preferences.ts with procedures: get (returns user's prefs or defaults), update (partial update), reset (delete row to revert to defaults). Register in src/trpc/index.ts. Use protectedProcedure for all. Follow the pattern in existing routers like deployment.ts.

tasks.name: frontend-preferences
tasks.description: Add preferences page in frontend settings
tasks.prompt: Create a settings/preferences page at app/settings/preferences/page.tsx. Use tRPC to load and save preferences. Include theme selector (system/light/dark), email notification toggle, and a dashboard layout dropdown. Use shadcn/ui components. Follow existing page patterns.

tasks.name: tests-preferences
tasks.description: Write tests for the preferences router
tasks.prompt: Write Vitest tests for the preferences tRPC router. Test: get returns defaults for new user, update persists changes, reset removes the row, update with invalid theme fails validation. Follow the test patterns in existing router test files.
